## Model Details

This model is an MXFP4 (mixed MXFP4 experts / MXFP8 PLE table, attention kept in BF16) model of [Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) generated by [intel/auto-round](https://github.com/intel/auto-round) using RTN. Please follow the license of the original model.

- **Quantized (MXFP4)**: routed experts, PLE table (MXFP8)
- **Kept in BF16**: attention, router, embeddings, lm_head, vision tower, shared expert, MTP

## How to Use

### Environment

```bash
uv pip install --index-strategy unsafe-best-match \
    --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/9815732c16ca076c60b65fccd787167d6a9c5328/cu130 \
    "vllm==0.29.1rc1.dev528+g9815732c1"
python - <<'PY'
from importlib.util import find_spec
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

spec = find_spec("vllm")
if spec is None or spec.origin is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Install the pinned vLLM build first")
root = Path(spec.origin).parent.parent
for filename in ['patches/qwen38fn-ct-ple-dev528.patch']:
    patch = hf_hub_download("intel-ai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MXFP4-BF16Attn-PLEMXFP8-CT-AutoRound", filename, revision="0fecfc25d6dc54b5a67cd9737aadaf1ff3432cce")
    command = ["patch", "--batch", "--fuzz=0", "-p1", "-d", str(root), "-i", patch]
    reverse = subprocess.run(command + ["--reverse", "--dry-run"], capture_output=True)
    if reverse.returncode == 0:
        print(filename + ": already applied")
        continue
    subprocess.run(command + ["--forward", "--dry-run"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(command + ["--forward"], check=True)
PY
```

### vLLM Usage

```bash
vllm serve intel-ai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MXFP4-BF16Attn-PLEMXFP8-CT-AutoRound \
    --reasoning-parser qwen3
```

## Evaluation

| Benchmark | BF16 | MXFP4 | Recovery |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| GSM8K | 96.74 | 96.36 | 99.61% |
| MMLU | 86.52 | 86.50 | 99.98% |
| PIQA | 81.94 | 81.50 | 99.46% |
| HellaSwag | 69.27 | 68.34 | 98.66% |
| **Average** | **83.62** | **83.18** | **99.47%** |

## Generate the Model

```bash
auto-round \
    --model_name Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next \
    --model_free \
    --scheme MXFP8 \
    --ignore_layers "visual,lm_head,embed_tokens,mlp.gate,mlp.shared_expert_gate,in_proj_a,in_proj_b,block_inject_weight,ple,mtp,hyper_connection,indexer,shared_expert,self_attn,linear_attn" \
    --layer_config "{mlp.experts:{bits:4,data_type:mx_fp}}" \
    --format llm_compressor \
    --output_dir Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MXFP4-BF16Attn-PLEMXFP8-CT-AutoRound
```

The command above generates an intermediate checkpoint: it leaves the PLE table unconverted. Producing the published model additionally requires the original `convert_ple_to_mxfp8.py` offline conversion. That script is not included in this repository; obtain it from the model maintainer before attempting full regeneration. The published weights already contain the converted PLE table and require the vLLM patch installed above.

## Ethical Considerations and Limitations

The model can produce factually incorrect output, and should not be relied on to produce factually accurate information. Because of the limitations of the pretrained model and the finetuning datasets, it is possible that this model could generate lewd, biased or otherwise offensive outputs.
Therefore, before deploying any applications of the model, developers should perform safety testing.

## Caveats and Recommendations

Users (both direct and downstream) should be made aware of the risks, biases and limitations of the model.
